1. Satellite frame: origin on the long axis at the -Z rail end; +Z = antenna end; X/Y faces as labelled. Third-angle projection.
2. Dispenser ICD: AODV-1 dispenser (in house) and commercial 3U dispensers per CDS rev 14.1. Rail ends are the only contact faces; panels and cells sit 0.1 below the
3. Orbit-average power 3.1 W tumbling vs 1.8 W load; battery 51 Wh (design/design-basis.md).
4. Mass is the current best estimate: structure from the CAD volumes, boards and harness estimated until the KiCad boards exist. Weigh at AON-900 T13 and update.
